title.id: BEHONGCA: Inovasi Obat Kumur Herbal Berbasis Metode HTST
title.en: BEHONGCA: HTST Herbal Mouthwash Innovation for Dental Health

subtitle.id: Obat kumur herbal 100% bebas alkohol dari daun binahong, cangkang telur, mangga, krokot, dan cornmint — dilengkapi perangkat HTST, detektor plak, dan game edukasi.
subtitle.en: 100% alcohol-free herbal mouthwash crafted from binahong leaves, eggshells, mangoes, purslane, and cornmint — paired with an HTST smart device, plaque detector, and educational game.

registeredDocuments.title: BEHONGCA: Utilization of Binahong Leaves, Eggshells, and Mangoes Using the HTST Method for Dental Health
registeredDocuments.author: Arinda Rahmadina, Bagus Eka S., Chelsea Putri P., Clara Vanessa K., Davina Queen E.N, Rangga Raditya (SMP Negeri 1 Surakarta)
registeredDocuments.description: Official I2ASPO 2026 Applied Life Sciences research proposal covering botanical formulation (F1–F3), HTST pasteurization & thermal shock, n=90 Surakarta school survey, and the BEHONGCA SMART system.
